{{Quote|This place looks like a shrine to that strange warrior&hellip;|[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]|audio=ShrineToStrangeWarrior-LoG.flac|<ref name="decoded">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous|d=y}}</ref>}}
'''Grievous's castle''', also known as the '''lair of General Grievous''' was the personal retreat of the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Located on the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]], the castle was built into the rockface of a large gorge. Shrouded by the moon's heavy fog, Grievous's castle was specifically designed to cater to the needs of the general, with an operating and repair room, a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] for his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], and several booby traps intended for intruders. Aside from Grievous, the castle was the home to the general's repair [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[EV-A4-D/Legends|EV-A4-D]], [[Gor/Legends|Gor]], Grievous's pet [[Roggwart/Legends|roggwart]], and a cadre of [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] who protected the lair.

Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Grievous's sanctuary was [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|infiltrated]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]]. The Republic forces were trapped inside the castle by General Grievous, who locked down the facility. The general hunted the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] through the castle until only Kit Fisto remained. Fisto was able to disable the castle's control system and end the lockdown, allowing him to escape the third moon of Vassek and General Grievous's wrath.

==History==
{{Quote|Why don't you come out, General? Show us some of that Separatist hospitality.''"<br />"''Patience. In the meantime, please experience all my home has to offer. It has been prepared for uninvited guests, like ''you''.|audio=SeparatistHospitality-LoG.flac|Kit Fisto and Grievous|<ref name="decoded" />}}
[[File:GrievousSpareParts-LoG.png|thumb|left|200px|Grievous' lair held an entire chamber with spare parts.]]
[[File:Kaleesh_statues2.png|thumb|right|200px|Kaleesh statues depicting the General before he submitted to his 'changes.']]
[[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] kept a favored pet [[Roggwart/Legends|roggwart]] named [[Gor/Legends|Gor]] at his castle. The halls of the building were adorned with statues depicting the General<ref name="artoftcw">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> as a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] warrior with mechanical limbs. An extensive warehouse was stacked with replacement parts for the mechanical general, and Grievous kept the caretaker droid [[EV-A4-D/Legends|EV-A4-D]] on hand for times when he was injured and needed replacement droid parts installed. Other areas of the castle included the arena in which Grievous kept his pet roggwart Gor and another area where he stored trophies taken from dead [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. His castle also included a control room where he could monitor the halls. From the control room he could activate various traps including releasing Gor and triggering a trap door leading to a molten incinerator vat. The control room's door could only be opened by pressing a number of buttons in the correct order.

The castle also featured a room called the "Sanctum overlook."<ref name="decoded" /> Trade Federation [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] was believed to be hiding in the room after his [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|rescue]].

The castle was the site of a [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|skirmish]] between Grievous, [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]], and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].
